boundary: The green theorem proves an exact finite-bijection distribution statement: for a uniform 32-byte State, its eight little-endian four-byte words split into high 14-bit and low 18-bit coordinates; the eight masked-18-bit candidates are jointly uniform over (Fin (2^18))^8. This is only the block law. It does not establish independent answers for a shared oracle, a challenge/kernel/retry law, or a security bound.
